title: Ethnopharmacological relevance and anti-inflammatory mechanisms of Lycopi Herba in diabetic nephropathy: Integrated chemical profiling and pharmacological evaluation.
authors: Chen, Lu-Zhou; Yang, Shuai; Ren, Dong-Mei; Wang, Xiao-Ling; Shen, Tao; Wang, Xiao-Ning
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药泽兰提取物通过NF-kB/TNF-alpha/STAT3炎症轴改善糖尿病肾病的药理机制，核心为湿实验与网络药理学，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Lycopi Herba is a traditional Chinese medicine with blood-activating and stasis-resolving properties, traditionally prescribed to promote diuresis and alleviate edema. These traditional indications are closely related to the pathogenesis of diabetic nephropathy (DN), characterized by renal fibrosis and fluid retention. Although Lycopi Herba has demonstrated potential in treating renal diseases, it remains unclear whether it ameliorates DN by modulating specific inflammatory signaling networks through its multi-component material basis. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to systematically elucidate the therapeutic efficacy and molecular mechanisms by which the crude extract of Lycopi Herba (LHE) alleviates renal injury and inflammation in DN, employing an integrated strategy of chemical profiling, network pharmacology, and experimental validation. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The chemical profile of LHE was comprehensively characterized using a validated HPLC-DAD-ELSD method. The therapeutic effects of LHE on renal function, histopathology, and inflammatory responses were systematically assessed in streptozotocin (STZ)-induced diabetic mice and high glucose (HG)-stimulated human podocytes. Evaluations were performed using histopathological staining, ELISA, RT-qPCR, Western blotting, immunofluorescence, and molecular docking. Functional dissection was further conducted to evaluate the contributions of major triterpenoids and flavonoids. RESULTS: In vivo experiments demonstrated that LHE significantly ameliorated renal dysfunction and histopathological injury in DN mice, accompanied by notable reductions in fasting blood glucose and renal pro-inflammatory cytokines (TNF-alpha, IL-6, IL-1beta). In vitro mechanistic studies revealed that LHE specifically blocked the phosphorylation and nuclear translocation of STAT3 and NF-kappaB, the two core transcription factors of the NF-kappaB/TNF-alpha/STAT3 inflammatory axis. This anti-inflammatory effect was achieved via a multi-component synergistic strategy: ten major bioactive compounds were identified in LHE by validated HPLC analysis, among which the highly abundant pentacyclic triterpenoid ursolic acid (UA) exerted direct anti-inflammatory activity by regulating the NF-kappaB/TNF-alpha/STAT3 inflammatory axis, serving as the primary material basis for LHE's efficacy. Meanwhile, flavonoids such as quercetin, despite their extremely low abundance in LHE, exhibited extremely potent intrinsic anti-inflammatory activity: at the physiologically equivalent concentration converted from their actual content in LHE, they exerted relatively weak direct modulation of the core inflammatory axis, and mainly exerted their anti-inflammatory effects through other complementary signaling pathways. Together, these bioactive constituents collectively mediated the renoprotective effects of LHE. CONCLUSION: This study demonstrates that LHE ameliorates DN by targeting the NF-kappaB/TNF-alpha/STAT3 signaling axis, thereby suppressing renal inflammation through a multi-component combinatorial strategy. These findings validate the ethnopharmacological application of Lycopi Herba and offer new mechanistic insight into its potential as a phytopharmaceutical agent for DN management.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：泽兰（Lycopi Herba）是一种具有活血化瘀作用的中药，传统上用于促进利尿和减轻水肿。这些传统适应症与糖尿病肾病（diabetic nephropathy, DN）的发病机制密切相关，后者以肾纤维化和液体潴留为特征。尽管泽兰已显示出治疗肾脏疾病的潜力，但其是否通过其多组分物质基础调节特定炎症信号网络来改善DN仍不清楚。研究目的：本研究旨在采用化学谱分析、网络药理学和实验验证的综合策略，系统阐明泽兰粗提物（LHE）缓解DN肾损伤和炎症的治疗效果及分子机制。材料与方法：采用验证过的HPLC-DAD-ELSD方法全面表征LHE的化学谱。在链脲佐菌素（streptozotocin, STZ）诱导的糖尿病小鼠和高糖（high glucose, HG）刺激的人足细胞中，系统评估LHE对肾功能、组织病理学和炎症反应的治疗效果。评估采用组织病理学染色、ELISA、RT-qPCR、Western blotting、免疫荧光和分子对接等方法。进一步进行功能解析，以评估主要三萜类和黄酮类化合物的贡献。结果：体内实验表明，LHE显著改善DN小鼠的肾功能障碍和组织病理学损伤，同时伴有空腹血糖和肾脏促炎细胞因子（TNF-alpha、IL-6、IL-1beta）的显著降低。体外机制研究揭示，LHE特异性阻断STAT3和NF-kappaB（NF-kappaB/TNF-alpha/STAT3炎症轴的两个核心转录因子）的磷酸化和核转位。这种抗炎作用通过多组分协同策略实现：通过验证过的HPLC分析在LHE中鉴定出十种主要生物活性化合物，其中高丰度的五环三萜类化合物熊果酸（ursolic acid, UA）通过调节NF-kappaB/TNF-alpha/STAT3炎症轴发挥直接抗炎活性，作为LHE疗效的主要物质基础。同时，黄酮类化合物如槲皮素（quercetin），尽管在LHE中丰度极低，却表现出极强的固有抗炎活性：在根据其在LHE中实际含量换算的生理等效浓度下，它们对核心炎症轴的直接调节作用相对较弱，主要通过其他互补信号通路发挥抗炎作用。这些生物活性成分共同介导了LHE的肾脏保护作用。结论：本研究证明LHE通过靶向NF-kappaB/TNF-alpha/STAT3信号轴，以多组分组合策略抑制肾脏炎症，从而改善DN。这些发现验证了泽兰的民族药理学应用，并为其作为DN管理的植物药制剂潜力提供了新的机制见解。
